Kraft, white, bulk and custom ranges

If you have not settled on a size yet, start from the finish. Kraft gives a natural paper look and prints well in one or two colors; white poly is water-resistant and the better base for full-color print. Both are bubble-lined with the same 3/16 in padding. Our bulk bubble mailer bags page covers case and pallet buying across the six most-ordered sizes.

  • Kraft Bubble Mailers — 4 x 7 in (#000) to 14.25 x 19 in (#7). Cosmetics, books, apparel, boxed goods, retail orders.
  • White Bubble Mailers — 4 x 7 in (#000) to 10.5 x 15 in (#5). Beauty products, apparel accessories, subscription kits, retail orders.
  • Bulk Bubble Mailer Bags — 4 x 6 in up to 12 x 15 in. eCommerce orders, retail shipping, warehouse pack lines, subscription mailouts.
  • Bubble Mailer Packaging — Standard sizes from 4 x 6 in to 12 x 15 in, or custom. Branded shipping, retail packaging, warehouse order programs, campaigns.

Every size can be printed. Pricing for logo runs, artwork specifications and proofing are on the custom page, and the design tool on each product page gives an instant estimate for any combination.

FAQ

Bubble mailer sizes and ordering FAQs

Every standard size: inch sizes 4x6, 4x7, 6x9 (9x6), 7x9, 8.5x12, 10.5x15, 12x12 and 12x15, and the numbered range #000 through #7. Each has its own page with usable dimensions, what fits and a bulk starting price.

They describe the same mailers two ways. A #2 is 8.5 x 12 in outside, a #5 is 10.5 x 16, a #7 is 14.25 x 20. Inch sizes are the outer dimension; usable inside space is about an inch shorter because of the seal flap. Our comparison table lists both so you can order by either name.

Most online stores cover 80% of orders with two sizes: a 4x7 or 6x9 for small items and an 8.5x12 (#2) for folded apparel and multi-item orders. Add a 10.5x15 (#5) if you ship hoodies, denim or kits. Send us three or four typical products and we will suggest the spread.

By the case, typically 100 to 500 mailers depending on size, and by the pallet for 10,000 units and up. Both ship free to any US address; pallet programs are quoted with scheduled releases if you want them.

Plain stock at 5,000 units in the standard material for that size, before printing. Smaller quantities cost more per unit and larger ones less; custom print and specialty materials add to the figure. Every quote is confirmed in writing before anything ships.

Kraft runs the full #000 to #7 range. White poly runs #000 to #5 as stock, with larger white sizes available on program orders. Both can be printed.

Yes. Mixed-size orders are the norm for stores shipping more than one product type. They ship together on one invoice, and the price break is based on the combined quantity on most programs.

Yes. Ask for samples of the two or three sizes you are considering and pack your real products before committing. It is the quickest way to avoid a case of mailers that is half an inch too small.

All of our stock bubble mailers use a peel-and-seal adhesive strip. Tear strips, double seals and tamper-evident closures are available on custom runs.

Plain stock usually leaves within a few business days of payment; printed orders follow a digital proof. We confirm the lead time on your quote before you commit.
